001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.publisher;
002
003import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
004import java.time.Duration;
005import java.time.Instant;
006import java.util.AbstractCollection;
007import java.util.Iterator;
008import java.util.concurrent.ArrayBlockingQueue;
009import java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue;
010import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
011import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
012import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
013
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics.Gauge;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics.StandardMetric;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisherRegistry;
023
024/**
025 * An async publisher that uses a blocking queue and a single thread consumer.
026 * <p>
027 * {@link #close()} stops accepting new calls and waits up to the shutdown timeout for
028 * queued events and calls already waiting to enqueue to be written, then closes the
029 * appender. The worker thread is never interrupted, so outputs are not interrupted in the
030 * middle of I/O.
031 */
032public final class BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher implements LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher {
033
034        private final BlockingQueue<LogEvent> queue;
035
036        private final LogAppender appender;
037
038        private volatile boolean running = false;
039
040        private final AtomicInteger activeProducers = new AtomicInteger();
041
042        private final int bufferSize;
043
044        private final Worker worker;
045
046        private final LogAlerts alerts;
047
048        private Gauge eventsQueued = Gauge.noop();
049
050        private final Duration shutdownTimeout;
051
052        /*
053         * Queued by close() to wake the worker instead of interrupting it, which would land
054         * in the middle of whatever output I/O the worker is doing.
055         */
056        private static final LogEvent STOP = LogEvent.of(Instant.EPOCH, "", 0, Level.OFF, "", "", KeyValues.of(), null);
057
058        /**
059         * Creates the publisher with its own standalone {@link LogConfig} (not one shared
060         * with the rest of the application) for its {@link LogAlerts} - mainly useful
061         * standalone/in tests. Prefer {@link #of(LogAppender, int, LogAlerts)} when a
062         * {@link LogConfig} is already available.
063         * @param appender appenders.
064         * @param bufferSize the queue size.
065         * @return async publisher.
066         */
067        public static BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher of(LogAppender appender, int bufferSize) {
068                return of(appender, bufferSize, LogConfig.builder().build().alerts());
069        }
070
071        /**
072         * Creates the publisher.
073         * @param appender appenders.
074         * @param bufferSize the queue size.
075         * @param alerts alerts for reporting internal errors (interrupted queue puts, worker
076         * failures).
077         * @return async publisher.
078         */
079        public static BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher of(LogAppender appender, int bufferSize, LogAlerts alerts) {
080                return of(appender, bufferSize, alerts, Duration.ofMillis(LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT));
081        }
082
083        /**
084         * Creates the publisher.
085         * @param appender appenders.
086         * @param bufferSize the queue size.
087         * @param alerts alerts for reporting internal errors (interrupted queue puts, worker
088         * failures, and a shutdown that did not finish in time).
089         * @param shutdownTimeout how long {@link #close()} waits for queued events to be
090         * written.
091         * @return async publisher.
092         */
093        public static BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher of(LogAppender appender, int bufferSize, LogAlerts alerts,
094                        Duration shutdownTimeout) {
095                if (bufferSize <= 0) {
096                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("buffer size should be greater than 0");
097                }
098                if (shutdownTimeout.isNegative()) {
099                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("shutdown timeout should not be negative");
100                }
101                BlockingQueue<LogEvent> queue = new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(bufferSize);
102                return new BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher(appender, queue, bufferSize, alerts, shutdownTimeout);
103        }
104
105        private BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher(LogAppender appender, BlockingQueue<LogEvent> queue, int bufferSize,
106                        LogAlerts alerts, Duration shutdownTimeout) {
107                super();
108                this.appender = appender;
109                this.queue = queue;
110                this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
111                this.worker = new Worker();
112                this.alerts = alerts;
113                this.shutdownTimeout = shutdownTimeout;
114        }
115
116        @Override
117        public void log(LogEvent event) {
118                if (!running) {
119                        throw new IllegalStateException();
120                }
121                activeProducers.incrementAndGet();
122                try {
123                        // Close may have begun between the first check and registration.
124                        if (!running) {
125                                throw new IllegalStateException();
126                        }
127                        queue.put(event);
128                        eventsQueued.increment();
129                }
130                catch (InterruptedException e) {
131                        alerts.error(BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher.class, e);
132                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
133                }
134                finally {
135                        if (activeProducers.decrementAndGet() == 0 && !running) {
136                                // Wake a shutdown drain waiting for the last producer, even if its
137                                // put was interrupted. A full queue already gives the worker work.
138                                queue.offer(STOP);
139                        }
140                }
141        }
142
143        @Override
144        public void close() {
145                if (!running) {
146                        return;
147                }
148                running = false;
149                var tool = new InterruptUtil();
150                try {
151                        tool.maskInterruptFlag();
152                        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + shutdownTimeout.toNanos();
153                        /*
154                         * A full queue already gives the worker work. Do not wait for space or allow
155                         * an interrupted closer to skip waking an idle worker.
156                         */
157                        queue.offer(STOP);
158                        long remainingNanos = deadline - System.nanoTime();
159                        if (remainingNanos > 0) {
160                                TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.timedJoin(worker, remainingNanos);
161                        }
162                }
163                catch (InterruptedException e) {
164                        alerts.error(BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher.class, e);
165                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
166                        return;
167                }
168                finally {
169                        tool.unmaskInterruptFlag();
170                }
171                if (worker.isAlive()) {
172                        alerts.error(BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher.class,
173                                        new TimeoutException("Async publisher did not finish writing within " + shutdownTimeout.toMillis()
174                                                        + "ms of close; " + queuedEvents() + " events still queued"));
175                }
176        }
177
178        @SuppressWarnings("ReferenceEquality") // STOP is a private marker instance
179        private long queuedEvents() {
180                return queue.stream().filter(e -> e != STOP).count();
181        }
182
183        private void _close() {
184                appender.close();
185        }
186
187        @Override
188        public void start(LogConfig config) {
189                // The worker thread can only run once, so this also rejects start after close.
190                if (running || worker.getState() != Thread.State.NEW) {
191                        throw new IllegalStateException("BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher can only be started once");
192                }
193
194                // Like the synchronous publisher, the publisher owns starting its appender.
195                appender.start(config);
196                // Publish the gauge before enabling producers and starting the worker.
197                eventsQueued = config.metrics()
198                        .gauge(StandardMetric.EVENTS_QUEUED.metricName(), StandardMetric.EVENTS_QUEUED.level());
199                worker.setDaemon(true);
200                worker.setName(BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher.class.getSimpleName());
201                running = true;
202                worker.start();
203        }
204
205        @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse bug
206        void append(LogEvent[] events, int count) {
207                appender.append(events, count);
208        }
209
210        class Worker extends Thread {
211
212                final LogEvent[] buffer = new LogEvent[bufferSize];
213
214                final FakeCollection fake = new FakeCollection();
215
216                private boolean stopRequested;
217
218                @Override
219                public void run() {
220                        try {
221                                while (running && !stopRequested) {
222                                        try {
223                                                var event = queue.take();
224                                                fake.add(event);
225                                                drain();
226                                        }
227                                        catch (InterruptedException e) {
228                                                // Shutdown never interrupts the worker, so this came from
229                                                // elsewhere.
230                                                alerts.error(BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher.class, e);
231                                                break;
232                                        }
233                                        catch (Exception e) {
234                                                alerts.error(BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher.class, e);
235                                        }
236                                }
237                                running = false;
238                                drainRemaining();
239                        }
240                        finally {
241                                _close();
242                        }
243                }
244
245                private int drain() {
246                        try {
247                                int size = fake.size;
248                                int added = queue.drainTo(fake, bufferSize - size);
249                                if (fake.size > 0) {
250                                        eventsQueued.decrement(fake.size);
251                                        append(buffer, fake.size);
252                                }
253                                return added;
254                        }
255                        finally {
256                                fake.reset();
257                        }
258                }
259
260                /*
261                 * Everything still queued at shutdown, including events from producers that were
262                 * blocked on a full queue when close began.
263                 */
264                private void drainRemaining() {
265                        while (true) {
266                                try {
267                                        /*
268                                         * Check producer completion before the final drain: a producer can
269                                         * enqueue and finish between an empty drain and a later check. Once
270                                         * close has stopped admission and this count is zero, no producer can
271                                         * enqueue another event.
272                                         */
273                                        if (activeProducers.get() != 0) {
274                                                fake.add(queue.take());
275                                                drain();
276                                        }
277                                        else if (drain() == 0) {
278                                                return;
279                                        }
280                                }
281                                catch (Exception e) {
282                                        alerts.error(BlockingQueueAsyncLogPublisher.class, e);
283                                }
284                        }
285                }
286
287                class FakeCollection extends AbstractCollection<LogEvent> {
288
289                        private int size = 0;
290
291                        @Override
292                        @SuppressWarnings("ReferenceEquality") // STOP is a private marker instance
293                        public boolean add(LogEvent e) {
294                                if (e == STOP) {
295                                        stopRequested = true;
296                                        return false;
297                                }
298                                buffer[size] = e;
299                                size++;
300                                return true;
301                        }
302
303                        @Override
304                        public Iterator<LogEvent> iterator() {
305                                throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
306                        }
307
308                        @Override
309                        public int size() {
310                                return size;
311                        }
312
313                        void reset() {
314                                size = 0;
315                        }
316
317                }
318
319        }
320
321}
322
323class InterruptUtil {
324
325        final boolean previouslyInterrupted;
326
327        InterruptUtil() {
328                super();
329                previouslyInterrupted = Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted();
330        }
331
332        public void maskInterruptFlag() {
333                if (previouslyInterrupted) {
334                        Thread.interrupted();
335                }
336        }
337
338        public void unmaskInterruptFlag() {
339                if (previouslyInterrupted) {
340                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
341                }
342        }
343
344}
